label: 2. Master, I have a favor to ask, hehe.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Master, I have a favor to ask, hehe.
Hmm?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Do me a favor,

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: and I'll give you an amazing gift ♥
What's the favor?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Remember that ruckus at the Maid Cafe?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: You told me what to do,

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: and the girls ended up helping me out, right?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Setting Cocoa aside,

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: I haven't done anything for the other two.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: So I was thinking of getting them a little something.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Wanna help me out a bit, Master?
Everyone helped you without expecting anything in return.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Yeah, I know...

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: I'm just doing it 'cause I want to.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: I hate owing people anything.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: "You always pay back exactly what you take."

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: That's the number one rule in the underworld.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: You'd better remember that too, Master ♥
You're a maid now, so you don't really need to bother with that.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Old habits don't change overnight, you know?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: For now, I'm just sticking to what I'm used to.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: think you can give me a hand?
Let's go check it out together tomorrow.
I can help, but...

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Hehehehehe!

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Master,

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: I just knew you'd say that ♥

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: How about we meet

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: in front of the mall tomorrow at 9?
Sounds good to me.
But isn't buying a gift just an excuse?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: But...?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: What were you going to say...?
It seems like you're up to something else.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Hehe, you got me!
So, what are you really up to?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Of course, my real goal is to get gifts.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: But once I decided to buy them,

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: I thought, hey, why not have some fun along the way?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: It'd also be nice

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: if we could go on a little date while we're at it, Master.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: You're not going to ditch me just because of that, are you?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: I'm just trying to get a little closer

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: with the maids.
Whatever you're after, you seem to mean well.
So I'll go with you.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: For real?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Then tomorrow's a date!

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Whoops, I actually said "date"...

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: You know that's a typo, right? lol

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Anyway, that means you promised to help me tomorrow.
Sure thing,
and I'll be looking forward to the gift you mentioned.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Oh, so you didn't forget!

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Looks like you're not so easy to fool after all, Master.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Or... was that your plan from the start?

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Anyway, see you in front of the mall at 9 tomorrow.

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: Don't you dare be late

lines.speaker: velvet_m
lines.text: or you might end up with a punishment instead of a gift ♥
